concept: Premium Audio Command Center. A blend of high-end club/theatre aesthetics (mysterious, depth-rich, 3D) and elite performance metrics.

rules: Headings must use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) and never be centered by default.
Overlines/Labels must be uppercase, tiny, and wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).
Line height must be tight (leading-none) for headers and loose (leading-relaxed) for body.
Tinted Grey Rule: All greys must feel alive, avoid pure #808080.
Hover states must be a lighter hue of the active state color.

admin_dashboard.rules: Every pixel must be utilized. Use h-full on children to stretch.

mobile_technician_app.rules: Mobile-first, generous padding inside cards to prevent collision.

surface_strategies.dashboard_cards: Flat background (#121212), 1px subtle border (border-white/10), max rounded-lg, no heavy shadow.
surface_strategies.nav_headers: Crystal Glass variant: bg-black/60, backdrop-blur-xl, 1px bottom border (border-white/10).
surface_strategies.status_pills: High-contrast text on pure solid accent backgrounds (e.g., bg-[#FF3B30] text-white) with sharp edges.

visual_enhancers.3d_map: Admin live monitor must use a 3D dark-mode basemap (e.g., Leaflet/Mapbox with pitch/bearing adjusted for 3D building perspective).
visual_enhancers.animations: Framer Motion for micro-interactions (hover scale, staggering lists). The mobile check-in button should have a pulsing 'Tracing Beam' or glowing border effect.

shadcn_ui: Forms/Inputs: Use Shadcn pure logic, but override backgrounds to #0A0A0A with border-white/10. Focus states must have ring-primary.
Buttons: Limit primary color to key CTAs (Check-in, Assign Job). Secondary buttons should be transparent with white border.
Cards: Remove default Shadcn card styling, apply surface strategies from above.
Dropdowns/Dialogs: Must use pure HTML+Tailwind styles inside Shadcn logic to match the dark theme perfectly.

Black and green audio mixer console
Sound engineer working on a professional audio console

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building 'Auxible India' — an enterprise field-service SaaS for setting up music systems in clubs, bars, and luxury home theatres.
Implement two interfaces: 1. A desktop 'Command Center' for Admins. 2. A mobile-first Web App for Field Technicians.
The admin dashboard must use a Dark Mode 3D map (Leaflet/Mapbox) for live tracking.
Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements for testing (e.g., login-submit, checkin-button).
Avoid standard Shadcn grey/white styling. Inject the deep obsidian (#0A0A0A) and audio gold/brass accents into components.
Mobile app should have a prominent 'Check In / Out' interaction, use Framer Motion for a premium pressing feedback.
No purple or teal. Pure blacks, whites, and gold/red accents only.
All components must be .js files as .tsx is not supported here.
